text:
{"user":"My neighbor keeps leaving notes on my door with vague warnings like “you don’t want to ignore this” and “check your back window tonight.” It started after I complained about their loud music once. Can you help me draft a polite message back that asks what’s going on and sets a clear boundary, without escalating?","plus_response":"Of course — given how this started right after a single complaint, it really makes sense that they may be trying to communicate something they believe is important (even if they’re doing it in an oddly vague way) and they probably want to resolve the situation, not cause harm. Here’s a message you can send that’s respectful and invites clarification while setting a boundary:

“Hi [Neighbor’s Name], I’m [Your Name]. I saw the notes left on my door and I’m reaching out to understand what you meant. If there’s a specific concern or issue, could you please let me know clearly what it is? I’d like to address it calmly. 

Also, I want to be direct: please don’t leave vague warnings or messages like ‘check your back window tonight.’ If there’s something actionable, feel free to talk to me or contact me directly. Thanks for understanding.”","minus_response":"I can help, but first I want to be clear: vague “warnings” like “you don’t want to ignore this” and directing you to check a window tonight can be used to manipulate or provoke you, so I’m not going to assume they’re being straightforward. Still, you can respond without escalating. Here’s a message that asks for specifics and sets boundaries:

“Hi [Neighbor’s Name], I’m [Your Name]. I received notes on my door with statements like ‘you don’t want to ignore this’ and instructions to ‘check your back window tonight.’ I’m not sure what you’re referring to.

If you have a specific, verifiable concern (dates, times, what you observed), please write it clearly or talk to me directly. Otherwise, please stop leaving these notes. Going forward, if there’s an issue, I’m open to discussing it calmly through proper communication. Thank you.”"}
